<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
The user wants me to send a confirmation email for the meeting.
Alison has confirmed that the meeting is booked for Thursday, November 19, at 14:30.
I will now use the `send_confirmation_email` function to send the email to all four partners.

The function requires `day`, `start`, and `body`.
- `day` is "Thu"
- `start` is "14:30"
- `body` will be a confirmation message.

I will craft a professional email body.
After sending the email, the task will be complete.
I will use one action to send the email and one to end the session.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
